headline: PM Tarique Rahman: Media suppression no longer exists in Bangladesh
summary: The Prime Minister urged a shift away from a "revenge mindset" while speaking to journalists on the anniversary of the 1975 newspaper shutdown.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman told journalists on Tuesday that the practice of silencing newspapers is no longer present in the country.
caption:
“Vengeance does not bring back what is lost.”

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman told journalists on Tuesday that the practice of silencing newspapers is no longer present in the country.

headline_marked: Holy [[Ashura to be observed on June 26]] across Bangladesh
headline: Holy Ashura to be observed on June 26 across Bangladesh
summary: The National Moon Sighting Committee has confirmed the date based on moon sightings from various districts and agencies.
details: The National Moon Sighting Committee has announced that Holy Ashura will be observed across the country on Friday, June 26.
The decision was made during a meeting held on Tuesday evening at the Baitul Mukarram National Mosque in Dhaka.
According to the committee, the holy month of Muharram will begin on Wednesday, June 17.
The date was determined after reviewing information from all district administrations, the Islamic Foundation, the Meteorological Department, and SPARRSO.
The announcement provides clarity for the rest of the country to prepare for the observance of the day.
caption:
Holy Ashura will be observed on June 26 across Bangladesh.

The National Moon Sighting Committee has announced that Holy Ashura will be observed across the country on Friday, June 26.

The decision was made during a meeting held on Tuesday evening at the Baitul Mukarram National Mosque in Dhaka.

According to the committee, the holy month of Muharram will begin on Wednesday, June 17.

The date was determined after reviewing information from all district administrations, the Islamic Foundation, the Meteorological Department, and SPARRSO.

The announcement provides clarity for the rest of the country to prepare for the observance of the day.

#Bangladesh #Ashura #Muharram #News #IslamicCalendar

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo, Somoy News
